description: Hand-authored Increment 3c preview vectors. For each case the integration suite creates, in organization A, the custom fields plan (select: pro, basico), score (number), vip (boolean), birthday (date) and note (text); creates the contact; stores 'custom_values_json' (raw JSON text, so numeric forms such as 1.50 are kept); records consent when 'consent' is true; creates a template version, a sender identity and a draft campaign that pins that version; archives 'archive_fields'; calls public.email_campaign_preview_input; and renders its output with the Increment 3b renderer (renderTemplate + assembleDocument with the returned fixed preview footer). 'expected_values' and 'expected_contact' are the exact RPC output; 'expected' is the exact document or the render failure. Written by hand from EMAIL_CONTENT_V1_CONTRACT.md sections 7 and 9 and the fixed preview footer; never generated by the code under test.
